name: Great Men Don't Lie
source:
A capitalist goat gets into a secret affair with a "straight", married, and conservative podcaster dragon DILF. Despite it going against everything they stand for, they just can't quit each other or the hot, kinky sex they keep having, but will the consequences of their actions catch up to them?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371420/Great_Men_Dont_Lie/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一只信奉资本主义的山羊，与一位自称“纯直男”、已婚且立场保守的播客主播龙族熟男老爹搞起了地下婚外情。尽管这段关系违背了他们平素标榜的一切原则，两人却无论如何都戒不掉彼此，更戒不掉一次次火辣变态的鱼水之欢——但纸包不住火，他们迟早要为自己的所作所为付出代价吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371420/Great_Men_Dont_Lie/]Steam[/url]]
